decision: Do not promote a network-wide Hera energy price. The current official portal proves power/connector taxonomy and exact idle-fee rules but still does not expose the energy €/kWh in public indexed text. Treat 0.85 EUR/kWh from the May 2026 consumer observatory as a high-value lead only. Revisit HER only with first-party tariff payload, app/portal network capture, QR/POS price page, or refreshed exact PUN mapping.
resumeCondition: first-party Hera energy tariff payload or exact EVSE/station mapping from app/portal/QR/POS/backend
confidence: high for current portal taxonomy/idle fees and non-promotion decision; medium for third-party 0.85 EUR/kWh discovery lead
